title: Wire or remove DashboardPublisherImpl — eliminate dual SignalR push surface
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-MGR-001

`DashboardPublisherImpl` is registered in DI and composed into `AgentRuntime`, but none of its methods are ever called. ABS directly calls its own `PushStatusToDashboardAsync`, `PushChatToDashboardAsync`, and `PushGoalToDashboardAsync` — duplicating the same SignalR push logic. `QueuedActions` is hardcoded to 0, `_nearbyEntities` and `_blockBelow` are always null.

**Impact:** Dead code creating maintenance burden — two SignalR push paths to maintain, `AgentRuntime` registration is misleading.

**Recommendation:** Either delete `DashboardPublisherImpl` and the `IDashboardPublisher`/`AgentRuntime` registrations, or refactor ABS to delegate dashboard pushes to `DashboardPublisherImpl` through `AgentRuntime`. The latter is the Sprint 39/40 decomposition plan.
